notes: Focused public C++ TCK contract for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.5 p. 357 l. 61-19. The TCK supplies Credentials with an unrecognized type and empty data to public Connect while the protected RID selects the standard HLAauthorizer. Connect must report Unauthorized. This case does not treat InvalidCredentials or successful Connect as equivalent and does not claim broader authorization-service behavior or full §12.5 conformance.
